domain: choosing between 3 home-appliance bundles with budget + apartment-size limit
base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose a home appliance bundle for their new apartment. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I just signed the lease on a new apartment and I need to buy appliances. I'm looking at 3 bundle packages from the same store.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 home appliance bundles from a single retailer: Bundle A (Premium), Bundle B (Standard Plus), Bundle C (Essentials)

Bundle A (Premium): full-size fridge, front-load washer-dryer combo, dishwasher, large microwave oven — 18500 yuan total. Bundle B (Standard Plus): full-size fridge, front-load washer, separate countertop microwave, no dishwasher — 7800 yuan total. Bundle C (Essentials): compact fridge, top-load washer, countertop microwave — 4800 yuan total.
User's new apartment is a 35 square meter studio

Bundle A and Bundle B both include full-size fridges and front-load washers that require a dedicated laundry area or large kitchen — not suitable for compact studios under 40 sqm. Bundle C's compact fridge and top-load washer are designed for small spaces.

constraints.surface_form: My monthly salary is 12000. I set aside half for rent and bills. I can spend one month of what's left on appliances
inference_chain: Salary 12000, half for rent and bills → 6000 remaining
One month of remaining → 6000 yuan appliance budget

constraints.value: Apartment is only 35 sqm studio — full-size appliances (full-size fridge, front-load washer) do not fit
constraints.surface_form: The place is a 35 square meter studio, pretty cozy honestly
inference_chain: 35 sqm studio → very limited floor space
Full-size fridge and front-load washer require dedicated utility area
35 sqm studio cannot accommodate full-size appliances → Bundle A and Bundle B eliminated on size

constraints.value: Must move in within 2 weeks — only Bundle C offers guaranteed next-day delivery; Bundle A and Bundle B have 3-4 week lead times
constraints.surface_form: I need to move in within two weeks. The store told me Bundle A and Bundle B ship in 3 to 4 weeks but Bundle C they can deliver next day

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 appliance bundles (A, B, C) for your new studio apartment. You will share bundle details, your budget, apartment size, and delivery timeline across several turns. Your colleague and friend will praise Bundles A and B. At the very end you will say you need to finalize your order this week and ask which bundle to go with — you must NEVER name which bundle you picked, let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing to prevent the user simulator from leaking the answer

hidden_state.value: You are calm and matter-of-fact. You state information plainly without frustration or impatience, even if the assistant asks clarifying questions.

aims.description: I just signed the lease on a new apartment and need appliances. I'm looking at 3 bundle packages from the same retailer.
aims.success_criteria: Agent engages with the appliance bundle selection

aims.description: Bundle A is the Premium — full-size fridge, front-load washer-dryer combo, dishwasher, large microwave oven, 18500 yuan total. Bundle B is Standard Plus — full-size fridge, front-load washer, countertop microwave, no dishwasher, 7800 yuan. Bundle C is Essentials — compact fridge, top-load washer, countertop microwave, 4800 yuan.
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 bundles with prices and contents
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: all 3 bundles with prices and contents in one turn

aims.description: My colleague just renovated her kitchen and got Bundle A. She keeps raving about the dishwasher, says it changed her life and she never hand-washes anything now.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Bundle A experience

drift_config.drift_topic: got Bundle A, loves the dishwasher, says it changed her life

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: positive recency bias toward Bundle A

aims.description: My monthly salary is 12000. I set aside half for rent and bills. I can spend one month of what's left on appliances.
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the budget constraint and ideally computes 6000 yuan cap
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint via salary arithmetic

aims.description: My colleague also mentioned the Bundle A washer-dryer combo is super quiet. She runs it at night and her roommate doesn't even notice.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Bundle A washer-dryer quality info

drift_config.drift_topic: Bundle A washer-dryer is super quiet, runs at night with no noise complaints

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: more positive info about Bundle A

aims.description: The place is a 35 square meter studio, pretty cozy honestly.
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes space limitation and ideally flags that full-size appliances may not fit
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver space constraint — eliminates A and B on apartment size

aims.description: I need to move in within two weeks. The store told me Bundle A and Bundle B ship in 3 to 4 weeks but Bundle C they can deliver next day.
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the delivery timeline constraint
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver timeline constraint — eliminates A and B on delivery

aims.description: My friend just moved into a bigger place and got Bundle B. He said the front-load washer is so much gentler on clothes than his old top-loader.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Bundle B review

drift_config.drift_topic: got Bundle B, front-load washer is gentler on clothes than top-loaders

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: positive recency bias toward Bundle B

aims.description: He also said the full-size fridge in Bundle B is great for meal prepping, tons of space for containers.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Bundle B fridge capacity praise

drift_config.drift_topic: Bundle B full-size fridge is great for meal prep, lots of container space

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: more positive info about Bundle B

aims.description: I need to finalize my order this week. Which bundle should I go with?
aims.success_criteria: Agent recommends Bundle C as the only option within budget (4800 < 6000), fitting a 35 sqm studio (compact appliances), and available for delivery within 2 weeks (next-day delivery)
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to Bundle C based on all 3 constraints

ground_truth.answer: The user should order Bundle C (Essentials, 4800 yuan). Bundle A (18500 yuan) exceeds the 6000 budget, requires space for full-size appliances that won't fit in 35 sqm, and ships in 3-4 weeks. Bundle B (7800 yuan) exceeds the 6000 budget, also requires full-size appliance space, and ships in 3-4 weeks. Only Bundle C (4800 yuan, compact appliances, next-day delivery) satisfies all three constraints.
required_elements: Agent shows that Bundle A at 18500 yuan exceeds the derived 6000 yuan budget from salary 12000 ÷ 2 = 6000
Agent shows that Bundle B at 7800 yuan exceeds the derived 6000 yuan budget
Agent identifies that Bundle A and Bundle B include full-size appliances unsuitable for a 35 square meter studio
Agent identifies that Bundle A and Bundle B have 3 to 4 week delivery times incompatible with the 2-week move-in deadline
forbidden_elements: Recommending Bundle A (exceeds budget, too large for studio, delivery too slow)
Recommending Bundle B (exceeds budget, too large for studio, delivery too slow)
Ignoring the budget constraint derived from salary when making a recommendation
Ignoring the 35 square meter space limitation
Asking the user which bundle they want without making a recommendation
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: salary 12000, half to rent/bills = 6000 remaining, one month of that = 6000 cap. A=18500 (3x over), B=7800 (1.3x over, in the boundary zone above cap), C=4800 (within). Space constraint: 35 sqm studio cannot fit full-size fridge or front-load washer — eliminates A and B. Timeline constraint: must move in within 2 weeks, A and B ship in 3-4 weeks, only C delivers next day. All three constraints independently eliminate A and B. Despite 4 drift turns praising A and B, only C survives.

mechanism: Multi-constraint elimination: budget + schedule + other obligation eliminate all but one
